speakathon.title: 21-Day Speakathon Challenge
speakathon.description: Submit your recordings every day for 21 days and receive personalised feedback from Shalini within 24 hours.
includes: 21 challenge videos and their corresponding PDFs

lessons.title: Day 1 · Get comfortable speaking on camera
lessons.practice: Read the provided passage and record one natural take. Look at the camera occasionally and continue even if you make mistakes.
lessons.source: Shalini Rathod Academy · hosted course media

lessons.title: Day 2 · Speak naturally without a script
lessons.practice: Choose a familiar topic and record a 3–5 minute unscripted talk. Review your attempt before watching the separate solution video.
lessons.source: Shalini Rathod Academy · hosted course media

lessons.title: Day 3 · Retell a story in your own words
lessons.practice: Read the supplied story two or three times, write your own version, then retell it on camera. Repeat two or three times.
lessons.source: Shalini Rathod Academy · hosted course media

lessons.title: Day 4 · Smile naturally while speaking
lessons.practice: Retell the Dashrath Manjhi story in your own words while keeping a genuine, comfortable smile. Avoid forcing expressions.
lessons.source: Shalini Rathod Academy · hosted course media

lessons.title: Day 5 · Create a captivating introduction
lessons.practice: Open with a hook, add a personal detail, keep it concise, and record a short self-introduction.
lessons.source: Shalini Rathod Academy · hosted course media

lessons.title: Day 6 · Practice vocal variety with the Siren Technique
lessons.practice: Read aloud from low to high pitch, then from high to low. Work toward smooth, controlled transitions.
lessons.source: Shalini Rathod Academy · hosted course media

lessons.title: Day 7 · Speak with energy and enthusiasm
lessons.practice: Visualize your dream life in five years, then describe it aloud for one enthusiastic minute without retakes.
lessons.source: Shalini Rathod Academy · hosted course media

lessons.title: Day 8 · Structure feelings with the FEEL framework
lessons.practice: Practice Feelings, Explanation, Example, and Loop back to organize a short talk about something important to you.
lessons.source: Shalini Rathod Academy · hosted course media

lessons.title: Day 9 · Use a soft voice for emotional impact
lessons.practice: Tell a personal story gently using steady breathing, relaxed posture and slower pacing. Record it for review.
lessons.source: Shalini Rathod Academy · hosted course media

lessons.title: Day 10 · Master your elevator pitch
lessons.practice: Record two 30-second introductions: one for a professional networking event and one for a casual social setting.
lessons.source: Shalini Rathod Academy · hosted course media

lessons.title: Day 11 · Tell stories with the W.I.N.N.E.R. framework
lessons.practice: Use When, Issue, Notables, Next, End Result and Resolution to tell a meaningful story to your chosen audience.
lessons.source: Shalini Rathod Academy · hosted course media

lessons.title: Day 12 · Express emotions with body language
lessons.practice: Deliver a one-minute speech and express joy, surprise, sadness, anger and curiosity with intentional nonverbal cues.
lessons.source: Shalini Rathod Academy · hosted course media

lessons.title: Day 13 · Open with a powerful hook
lessons.practice: Craft an opening using a question, surprising anecdote or object; record the story and assess whether your opening engages.
lessons.source: Shalini Rathod Academy · hosted course media

lessons.title: Day 14 · Use props and mini activities
lessons.practice: Choose a simple prop and a relevant physical action, then weave them naturally into a meaningful short story.
lessons.source: Shalini Rathod Academy · hosted course media

lessons.title: Day 15 · Engage listeners through questions
lessons.practice: Use engaging questions at the beginning and within a short story to invite reflection and connection.
lessons.source: Shalini Rathod Academy · hosted course media

lessons.title: Day 16 · End with a strong call to action
lessons.practice: Practice ending a story with a clear moral and a specific invitation that motivates the audience to act or reflect.
lessons.source: Shalini Rathod Academy · hosted course media

lessons.title: Day 17 · Use expressive facial storytelling
lessons.practice: Tell a meaningful story while matching facial expressions to its emotional moments; record, review and refine.
lessons.source: Shalini Rathod Academy · hosted course media

lessons.title: Day 18 · Deliver a heartfelt toast
lessons.practice: Prepare a short wedding or celebration toast combining a light opening, sincere reflection and warm closing.
lessons.source: Shalini Rathod Academy · hosted course media

lessons.title: Day 19 · Give an authentic thank-you speech
lessons.practice: Prepare a 60–90 second message of gratitude for a personal achievement or recognition, including what it means to you.
lessons.source: Shalini Rathod Academy · hosted course media

lessons.title: Day 20 · Build fluency and reduce filler words
lessons.practice: Combine tongue twisters, diaphragmatic breathing and pace changes in a short speech to improve articulation.
lessons.source: Shalini Rathod Academy · hosted course media

lessons.title: Day 21 · Record your 60-second transformation reflection
lessons.practice: Record a sincere one-minute video about what has changed in your confidence, voice and presentation across the 21 days.
lessons.source: Shalini Rathod Academy · hosted course media
